name: Factacct ActualAccunting segment selects postingtype A, tenant-scoped
note: Segment coverage for the general ledger. postingtype='A' is correct here - the column genuinely holds A (15.6M rows), S, E and B - so unlike the Cashflowplan and Orderfacts segments this one already worked. The case exists to keep it that way. One month only: fact_acct is the largest table in the model.
referenceSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM fact_acct fa JOIN c_elementvalue ev ON fa.account_id=ev.c_elementvalue_id JOIN c_acctschema sch ON fa.c_acctschema_id=sch.c_acctschema_id WHERE fa.ad_client_id=1000026 AND fa.postingtype='A' AND fa.dateacct >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND fa.dateacct < DATE '2026-02-01'
